posts.text: Company: Swastika Castal Ltd Sector: Castings Exchange: BSE SME Basic Details • Market Cap: Rs 75 crores • Issue Price: Rs 65 • Current Price: 91 • Listing Date: 28 July 2025 Swastika Castal Limited, incorporated in 1996, is a Vadodara-headquartered manufacturer of high-precision aluminum castings. The company specializes in multiple casting processes including sand casting, gravity die casting, and centrifugal casting, enabling it to cater to diverse industrial applications requiring structural strength, dimensional accuracy, and durability.
